# Saydraft

> Free, open-source offline dictation for Windows. Speech recognition and cleanup run locally with compatible models installed.

Development preview available from source; no public signed installer is advertised. Model installation is an explicit reviewed action. Speech-language coverage is not a measured accuracy guarantee; the public baseline exposes substantial Bengali, Tamil and Telugu errors. Optional AI and experimental editing require their separate setup.

# Saydraft Changelog and Release Status

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/changelog/

Read Saydraft's published release history and current build status. Release notes are fetched from GitHub during the website build.

This page shows the latest public GitHub Releases as checked during the website build. Preview releases are labelled. Draft builds stay private and are excluded from the list; source commits are not presented as published app releases.

 

## Saydraft 0.1.1 preview — voice notes and cleanup repairs

2026-11-17 · Preview release

F10 now records a proper voice note: press once to start, wait for **Recording note**, then press again to stop. Find it in **Notes** and **History**. Hub → Notes also has a Record note button, and Settings → Shortcuts exposes the binding. Existing custom bindings are preserved. Your current Scratchpad draft stays unchanged; voice notes do not read or paste into another app's field. Cleanup now rejects added punctuation around the literal word “comma.” CPU startup prepares speech before optional cleanup calibration, and cleanup admission reserves time for RPC/scheduling overhead while keeping its 800 ms cap. All four full native cleanup suites pass their scoped checker: 2,624 cases, zero golden regressions. CPU production policy still uses rules for most text and accepted only one golden model reply; this is not broad accuracy, hardware-tier or end-to-end latency acceptance. This unsigned Windows x64 portable is built from clean source `dcfab880d1896f1fbdb32be7e34387c2b46b0ad5`, with version 0.1.1. Quit the previous Saydraft instance, extract the whole ZIP, and run **Saydraft.exe**. Keep its support files together. Windows may show an unknown-publisher/SmartScreen prompt. Models are installed separately through the existing explicit setup download flow; verified installed models are reused. Focused worker/UI/SQLite, synthetic shortcut and packaging checks pass. The actual frozen package and payload hashes are verified separately before upload. Physical microphone/hotkey/in

Models are not bundled in the ZIP. This is a development preview. # Saydraft Credits — Models, Libraries and Font Licenses

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/credits/

Credits for NVIDIA Parakeet, Whisper, Qwen, local runtimes, adapted dictionary data and the complete OFL notices for Saydraft's self-hosted fonts.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

Saydraft’s application code is [MIT licensed](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/LICENSE). Models, fonts, adapted data and libraries retain their own terms. The complete [third-party notices](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) record versions, source links, transformations and full notices.

 

## Speech and editing models

 

- NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 and v2: original weights by NVIDIA under [CC-BY-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The sherpa-onnx project exported ONNX and quantized the catalog versions to int8. Saydraft retains those converted files without further changes. Original cards: [v3](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3) and [v2](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2).
 
- Whisper: original OpenAI models under MIT. SYSTRAN supplies the base/small/medium CTranslate2 conversions; Mobius Labs / Dropbox supplies the [large-v3-turbo conversion](https://huggingface.co/dropbox-dash/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo). sherpa-onnx supplies the ONNX/int8 tiny language-detector conversion.
 
- Qwen3.5: original weights by Qwen, with Bartowski GGUF quantizations, under Apache-2.0. Optional cleanup and experimental editing are separate tasks.
 
- Nemotron streaming preview: NVIDIA’s optional English preview model uses the NVIDIA Open Model License. Its complete agreement and required attribution remain separate from MIT and are shown for its Labs setup.
 
- GTCRN: Rong Xiaobin’s MIT model, converted to ONNX by sherpa-onnx, is an optional experimental quiet-speech dependency.
 
- Silero VAD: the Silero Team’s MIT speech-detection model. Experimental meeting speakers use CNRS / pyannote segmentation under MIT and Alibaba / ModelScope 3D-Speaker ERes2Net-Base under Apache-2.0, with sherpa conversion attribution retained.

 

See [model choices](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/models/) for roles and download sizes. Being present in the catalog does not enable a model or establish its accuracy. Developer evaluation candidates are not recommendations.

 

## Local software foundations

 

The app builds on Python, Qt / PySide6, NumPy, soundfile / libsndfile, PyAV / FFmpeg, sounddevice / PortAudio, SoundCard, CTranslate2, faster-whisper, sherpa-onnx, ONNX Runtime, WebRTC VAD, comtypes and Metaphone. Optional local cleanup uses llama.cpp / ggml and its separately retained runtime notices.

 

These dependencies have individual terms, including LGPL, BSD, MIT and Apache licenses. The package’s collected component/version/source/hash inventory and complete notices accompany its actual frozen module graph. Refer to the full notices rather than treating this short credit list as a replacement.

 

## Dictionary data and recordings

 

Bundled common-word membership sets adapt wordfreq 3.1.1, copyright 2022 Robyn Speer, under [CC-BY-SA-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Source credits include freely available SUBTLEX data by Marc Brysbaert et al., Google Books Ngrams, Leeds, Wikipedia, ParaCrawl and OpenSubtitles. The [dataset notice and changes](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/assets/dictionary/frequency/wordfreq-NOTICE.md) and [provenance manifest](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/assets/dictionary/frequency/manifest.json) retain the complete credits. These adapted data are separate from the app’s MIT code.

 

Public evaluation recordings retain their own licenses and contributor credits in the repository’s fixture and evaluation records. This site uses a silent, canned visual example rather than recording your voice.

 

## The type on this page

 

The website uses Familjen Grotesk for display text, Geist for body text, Martian Mono for labels and Doto for the instrument readout. Bengali and Arabic use Noto fallbacks. All use SIL Open Font License 1.1. The site self-hosts pinned Fontsource files. The complete original notices are retained below, including Geist Mono and Instrument Serif for the existing desktop/reference assets.

## The website

 

Created by [Tanzir Rahman](https://tanziro.com/). Built with Astro and React, with Storybook for component states. Its inline SVG and text illustrations are original. No competitor logos, stock photos or unverified endorsements are used. Creator and support links appear in the footer.

## A few useful answers.

### Does the app's MIT license cover every model?

No. Saydraft's own code is MIT licensed. Models, libraries, fonts and adapted data retain their separate licenses and attribution requirements, shown in setup and the full third-party notices.

### Does this website load fonts from a CDN?

No. Its pinned Fontsource webfonts and complete original OFL notices are self-hosted. Ordinary credit links request no external assets unless you follow them.

# Voice Coding and Dictation for Developers | Saydraft

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/dictation-for-developers/

Use local Windows dictation for coding prompts, notes and commit messages. Learn Saydraft's Code mode, dictionary, shortcuts and review limits.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

Voice typing is useful for the prose around development: a prompt for a coding assistant, a bug report, a design note or a commit-message draft. Saydraft runs speech models locally on Windows and lets you review the resulting text.

 

Use it in a supported editable field in VS Code, Cursor, a browser or another editor. There is no dedicated Cursor, Claude Code or Codex integration. Test the actual field and privilege level you use before relying on automatic delivery.

 

## Choose processing that fits the text

 

Use Code mode when prose rewriting could damage literal material. Raw mode is another option for retaining recognized wording. Neither mode turns the speech recognizer into a syntax-aware programming tool: identifiers, paths, symbols and shell commands still need review.

 

For a natural-language issue or email, a Style can choose a different tone and cleanup intensity. Keep technical terms in the dictionary, and use snippets for known text you deliberately want to insert.

 

## A practical first workflow

 

- Complete [local model setup](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/getting-started/).
 
- Start in a scratch document, then try your real editor’s input field.
 
- Dictate a short plain-language prompt and check names, negation and numbers.
 
- Copy the reviewed result when a field cannot support safe automatic insertion.

 

Avoid treating spoken terminal text as permission to execute it. Review an instruction before pressing Enter yourself. Optional spoken-Enter behavior is separate and off by default.

 

## Experimental editing tools

 

Pro/Labs Command Mode can edit selected text with a separately installed local model. Ask can explain selected text in a separate answer note. These features have bounded selection and output checks, but those checks do not prove that every answer or edit preserves meaning.

 

Saydraft has an [unsigned Windows portable preview](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/download/) and source setup. Broader native workflow qualification, language accuracy and release latency remain in progress. The [offline guide](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/offline-dictation-windows/) explains model and privacy trade-offs before you choose a daily workflow.

## A few useful answers.

### Can I use Saydraft with VS Code, Cursor or a coding assistant?

Saydraft can deliver text to supported editable Windows fields. Try the exact editor or terminal field you use; it has no dedicated integration with those products, and field or privilege restrictions can require Copy recovery.

### Will Code mode turn speech into correct program syntax?

Code mode avoids ordinary prose cleanup. It is not a programming-language parser and cannot guarantee correct identifiers, punctuation, commands or generated code. Review the result before running it.

## Sources and further reading

- [Saydraft styles and Code mode ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/STYLES.md)

- [Source setup and current qualification ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft)

- [Experimental Command Mode ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/COMMAND_MODE.md)

# Saydraft Command Mode — Edit Selected Text Locally

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/command-mode/

Set up experimental Saydraft Command Mode, hold a shortcut to edit selected text, cancel with Escape and recover validated results with Copy.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

Command Mode is experimental and off by default. Full physical shortcut and packaged interaction acceptance remain in progress.

 

## Review the local editing setup

 

Use the Pro hardware/performance profile. In Settings → Labs → Command and Translate, review the editing model/runtime, sizes, sources and licenses. Choose Download / Resume editing model, then enable Command Mode and Save.

 

Downloading starts no recording and does not enable the feature. The editing model is separate from ordinary speech and cleanup settings. Standard shows Needs Pro tier before Command target/model/microphone work.

 

## Select, hold and instruct

 

- Select the complete text you want to edit.
 
- Hold Ctrl + Win + Alt and wait for the Command label before speaking.
 
- Say a short instruction such as “make this shorter”, “make this more formal” or “turn this into bullets”.
 
- Release the shortcut to edit. Escape cancels.

 

The model works locally on the reviewed selection and instruction. A validated complete result can replace the original selection after target checks. It can still be imperfect; review wording and meaning before using it elsewhere.

 

## When the app cannot expose a selection

 

Allow clipboard-copy fallback is a separate, default-off Labs setting. Enable and save it only if you want that route. Keep your text selected, record the instruction and release all shortcut modifiers. The fallback uses ordinary Ctrl+C in the original known-safe field and restores the current clipboard.

 

Windows and target-app clipboard history or sync can retain that copy. Restoring the current clipboard cannot retract those entries. Read [the clipboard privacy boundary](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/privacy/) before enabling fallback.

 

## Copy and recovery

 

When the original selection cannot be verified for replacement, a validated result is offered for Copy. A changed, unknown or password field can refuse the operation. History records the instruction and available result locally; an unsuccessful generation or validation can preserve the heard instruction for review. Command rows do not use ordinary dictation paste-last or audio retry.

 

## Related local features

 

Translate while speaking uses an independent Labs choice and Style output target. Ask about a selection produces a separate local answer rather than replacing source text. The shared editing download does not enable either feature. See [Style and spoken translation](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/styles/) and the [Ask implementation guide](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/ASK.md).

## A few useful answers.

### Does downloading the editing model enable Command Mode?

No. Downloading, enabling Command Mode and enabling its clipboard fallback are separate actions. Command is off by default and also requires the Pro profile.

### Why did I get Copy instead of automatic replacement?

The app offers a validated result for Copy when it cannot verify the original selection for replacement. Changed or protected targets can prevent delivery.

## Sources and further reading

- [Command setup, editing and current qualification ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/COMMAND_MODE.md)

- [Separate clipboard-copy fallback and its boundaries ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/COMMAND_CLIPBOARD.md)

# Saydraft Dictionary — Names, Replacements and Learning

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/dictionary/

Add names and protected terms to Saydraft, use explicit replacements, preview edits, and choose optional local correction suggestions and Undo.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

## Add the spelling you want

 

Open Hub → Dictionary to add people, places and specialist terms. Protected terms help retain exact wording through cleanup. Use an explicit replacement pair when a particular recognized phrase should become another phrase, rather than expecting a fuzzy match to infer your intention.

 

Dictionary, replacement and protected-term edits are staged until Save. The [Style preview](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/styles/) includes those pending edits without writing them to disk. Fix an invalid draft before saving.

 

## Understand spelling correction

 

Normal resolved English dictation can use conservative phonetic and spelling evidence to correct close matches to dictionary names, without another ASR pass. Ambiguous targets, common words, numbers, code, identifiers and protected/literal text decline fuzzy changes. Explicit replacement pairs take priority.

 

Raw, Verbatim-ish, Code, translation, unknown or other languages and mixed scripts do not receive these English phonetic guesses. Longer unsupported entries retain their exact protection rather than being silently shortened. History retains the original recognized text alongside the processed result.

 

The public evaluation covers a limited English name set; it does not establish general or owner accuracy. See the linked investigation for its method and limits.

 

## Choose correction suggestions

 

Suggest words from corrections is experimental and off by default. When enabled, local observation of the original editable field can identify a narrow word correction after a dictation. The suggestion offers Add or Dismiss. It does not enable a cloud learning service.

 

Auto-add to dictionary is a separate, default-off choice available with suggestions. It saves eligible additions automatically and offers Undo after a successful save. Keep Auto-add off if you prefer to approve suggestions yourself. Native/manual behavior is still being qualified.

 

## Undo and conflicting edits

 

Undo belongs to that saved addition. It preserves unrelated dictionary changes and can decline when a newer/manual change has claimed the same term. It does not undo the words you edited in another app.

 

An edited stale dictionary draft is refused before shared settings are saved. Keep your draft, then use Reload Dictionary to review the latest saved version before trying again. Invalid data are not replaced with an empty dictionary.

 

## Keep the privacy boundary clear

 

Suggestions involve optional local field observation. Audio retention and Command Mode’s clipboard fallback are separate settings. Read [privacy](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/privacy/) for those boundaries, and use [troubleshooting](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/troubleshooting/) if saving or recognition behaves unexpectedly.

## A few useful answers.

### Does the dictionary guarantee correct recognition?

No. It can protect terms and support conservative spelling correction, but it does not retrain the speech model or establish accuracy for every word or language. Review the result.

### Will learning add words without asking?

Correction suggestions are off by default. Auto-add is a separate default-off choice; with it off, use Add or Dismiss for a suggestion. A successfully saved addition can offer Undo.

## Sources and further reading

- [Dictionary storage, suggestions and Undo ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/DICTIONARY_LEARNING.md)

- [Qualified correction scope and measured limits ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/spikes/biasing.md)

# Saydraft FAQ — Offline Dictation Questions Answered

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/faq/

Answers about offline Windows dictation, local models, Spanish and Asian languages, privacy, cleanup, History and Saydraft's experimental tools.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

## Start with a setup that fits

 

Use [Getting started](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/getting-started/) for the first run, then review [models](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/models/) and [language compatibility](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/languages/). Saydraft’s current app target is Windows 10 and 11, and it remains in development.

 

## Find more detail

 

For saved data, network exceptions and clipboard boundaries, read [Privacy](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/privacy/). For input or delivery issues, use [Troubleshooting](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/troubleshooting/). The questions below summarize those guides; the linked source records contain the implementation and measured limits.

## A few useful answers.

### Is Saydraft free?

Yes. Saydraft's own code is free and open source under MIT. Models, fonts, libraries and adapted data retain their separate licenses.

### Do I need an account or subscription?

No. The app uses local models without an account. Lite, Standard and Pro describe local hardware/performance profiles, not paid plans.

### Can I dictate without internet?

Yes, with compatible models installed first. Download setup is explicit and optional update checks are off by default. Missing model files are not fetched during recognition.

### Are Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese included?

Both are covered by Parakeet v3 and the shared All languages model. Portuguese uses pt, including Brazil; this is coverage rather than a claim of verified accuracy for every accent.

### What about Arabic, Bengali, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Thai?

They use the optional shared All languages model. Filipino/Tagalog, Hindi, Indonesian, Malay, Persian, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu and Vietnamese also use that shared route. There are no per-language packs.

### Will it get every word right?

No. Accuracy varies by language, model, accent and recording conditions. The public baseline exposes substantial Bengali, Tamil and Telugu errors. Review names, numbers and technical terms before using a draft.

### Do I need an AI cleanup model?

No. Deterministic cleanup rules work without a text model. Optional local AI needs its own model/runtime and can retain the rules result when unready, out of budget or rejected.

### Is Whisper mode a different speech model?

No. The experimental Microphone setting boosts quiet speech with gain, AGC and optional local enhancement. It works before the selected recognizer; its whispered-speech accuracy target remains unmeasured.

### Are recordings kept?

Audio retention is off by default. History stores recognized and processed text locally; choosing to retain audio is separate. Practice in setup stays in memory and creates no History entry.

### Does the website listen to me?

No. Its examples are canned visual simulations with no microphone access, tracking analytics or third-party font requests.

## Sources and further reading

- [Current feature and release status ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/readme.md)

- [Speech language coverage and accuracy limits ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/LANGUAGES.md)

- [Privacy and explicit network actions ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md)

# Getting Started with Saydraft — Offline Dictation Setup

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/getting-started/

Set up local speech models, choose your microphone, try a first dictation and learn Saydraft's Windows shortcuts with a step-by-step walkthrough.

Facts checked: 2026-11-16

## Step 1. Get the app

 

Download the [unsigned Windows x64 portable ZIP](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/download/) for Windows 10 or 11. Quit any older Saydraft instance from its tray, extract the whole ZIP and run Saydraft.exe. The portable includes its Python runtime. First-run setup guides you through the choices below; no installer is required.

 

## Step 2. Choose your microphone

 

On Microphone, keep Default Windows input or choose Refresh inputs to find a named device. Test input runs a ten-second, level-only check without transcription or saved audio. Check microphone privacy reads Windows permission status without opening an input. If access is blocked or unknown, follow the microphone-privacy link to review desktop-app access in Windows settings.

 

## Step 3. Review and install local models

 

The Models step also offers optional local AI cleanup. Leave it off to use rules immediately, or review a cleanup model’s size/license and explicitly download it. Finish saves the staged choices; enabling AI or choosing a model starts no transfer.

 

Check this PC gives a provisional capability recommendation. Use speech recommendation selects the suggested speech model; it does not benchmark it, enable AI cleanup or download anything.

 

Review the download size and licenses, then choose Download / Resume. Progress shows transfers and checksum verification; Pause is available. Installed packages are checked in the background and reused on later launches.

 

After installation, Check model performance measures the selected speech model with bundled audio, without a microphone or download. Preparation is separate from three timed samples. Stop check waits for native work to finish. Unavailable AI cleanup speed stays unmeasured, and a fast sample is not an everyday latency guarantee. See [model choices](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/models/).

 

For Arabic, Bengali, Chinese, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Thai or Urdu, add the optional shared All languages model. One download serves those languages; selecting a language starts no transfer. Portuguese, including Brazil, is also covered by the default model. See [language setup](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/languages/).

 

Next requires the selected model to be ready. Catalog packages must pass their file checks. An existing local Whisper directory can instead pass an explicit offline performance check while its files remain unchanged. Finish checks the current model again before saving. Cancelling setup preserves saved preferences; downloaded files remain separate.

 

## Step 4. Choose a shortcut and practice

 

Existing custom bindings are preserved. A fresh profile uses Ctrl + Win to dictate, with F9 as the alternate and Ctrl + Win + Space for hands-free. Learn shortcut listens while setup stays focused, for up to ten seconds; Escape cancels. Manual entry and conflict checks are also available.

 

Try it has chat and email fields inside setup. Preparing an installed model opens no microphone. Hold your shortcut or choose Record, then release or choose Stop and preview. Each practice recording is limited to one minute. Review raw words, cleaned text and edit chips. Practice audio stays in memory, creates no History entry and uses no external paste or clipboard. You can continue without recording.

 

If a stop or Settings change ends practice, choose Prepare practice explicitly when ready. If setup cannot confirm a stop, cancel and restart Saydraft as prompted.

 

## Step 5. Make it sound like you

 

Style quick pick offers Casual or Formal for Messages and Email. Its rules preview uses your last practice transcript or a labelled example. Finish saves changed choices and opens Home after practice stops; existing cleanup intensity and AI settings stay unchanged.

 

Later, use Hub → Style for app-group tones and intensity, Dictionary for names, and Snippets for frequently used text. AI cleanup is optional; rules work without a text model.

 

## Step 6. Try it offline

 

With compatible speech files installed, open an ordinary text editor and put the cursor in an editable field. Hold your shortcut, speak, then release. Disconnect Wi-Fi and try another sentence. Shift + Alt + Z pastes the last saved dictation. Review [offline verification](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/privacy/verify-offline/) for what the check proves and its boundaries.

 

## If something feels wrong

 

Check that the model is installed and the microphone meter responds. Start in a non-elevated text editor; password and protected fields are excluded. History keeps a saved transcript when an app cannot accept insertion. Continue with [troubleshooting](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/troubleshooting/) and keep private audio or text out of public issue reports.

## A few useful answers.

### Can I continue setup without recording?

Yes. The practice recording is optional. Installed speech files must still be ready, and Finish rechecks the current model before saving.

### Does the practice draft paste into another app?

No. Practice uses chat and email fields inside setup, keeps its audio in memory and creates no History entry or external clipboard/paste action.

## Sources and further reading

- [First-run setup, readiness and practice behavior ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/ONBOARDING.md)

- [Microphone selection and permission checks ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/MICROPHONE.md)

# Saydraft Documentation — Offline Voice Typing on Windows

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/

Set up Saydraft, learn Windows dictation shortcuts, choose local speech models, adjust styles and dictionary, and verify offline behavior.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

Saydraft turns speech into a local draft on Windows. Start with a compatible installed model, then choose the shortcuts and cleanup that fit your work. The app is in development; review its results before using them elsewhere.

 

## Set up and start speaking

 

- [Getting started](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/getting-started/) — microphone, model review, explicit downloads and an owned practice field.
 
- [Shortcuts](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/shortcuts/) — hold to speak, hands-free, cancellation and paste-last.
 
- [Local models](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/models/) — speech versus cleanup, sizes, licenses and offline reuse.
 
- [Languages](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/languages/) — compatible shared models, language pins and the difference between coverage and accuracy.

 

## Make it fit your writing

 

- [Styles and cleanup](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/styles/) — tones per app group, intensity, rules and optional AI.
 
- [Dictionary](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/dictionary/) — names, protected terms, replacements and optional correction suggestions.
 
- [Command Mode](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/command-mode/) — experimental selected-text editing and Copy recovery.

 

## Understand privacy and recover

 

- [Privacy](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/privacy/) — local History, recordings, explicit network actions and clipboard boundaries.
 
- [Verify offline](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/privacy/verify-offline/) — practical checks and optional packaged Firewall controls.
 
- [Troubleshooting](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/troubleshooting/) — input, model, recognition and delivery problems.
 
- [FAQ](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/faq/) — common questions in one place.

 

For releases, start with [Download and setup](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/download/) and the [published-release changelog](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/changelog/).

## A few useful answers.

### Where should I start?

Follow Getting started to review the current source build, select an input, explicitly install compatible speech models and try a short practice draft.

### Are the Pro features a paid plan?

No. Saydraft is free and open source. Lite, Standard and Pro describe local hardware/performance profiles; experimental editing still needs its compatible local model.

## Sources and further reading

- [Application guides and current implementation status ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/README.md)

# Saydraft Languages — Offline Speech Models and Pins

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/languages/

Choose Saydraft speech languages for Arabic, Bengali, Chinese, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese and more, with shared models.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

## Choose a model that covers your language

 

Parakeet v3 covers 25 European languages. The optional shared All languages package uses Whisper turbo for additional supported speech languages. These choices describe recognition coverage, not translated app UI or a guarantee for every accent, dialect or mixed-language passage.

 

The nineteen linked language guides are listed alphabetically by English display name. Settings includes the model’s other available language choices as well.

 

| Language guide | Code | Compatible setup |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Arabic](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/arabic/) | `ar` | All languages |
| [Bengali](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/bengali/) | `bn` | All languages |
| [Brazilian Portuguese](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/brazilian-portuguese/) | `pt` | Parakeet v3 or All languages |
| [Chinese (Mandarin)](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/chinese/) | `zh` | All languages |
| [Filipino / Tagalog](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/filipino-tagalog/) | `tl` | All languages |
| [French](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/french/) | `fr` | Parakeet v3 or All languages |
| [German](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/german/) | `de` | Parakeet v3 or All languages |
| [Hindi](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/hindi/) | `hi` | All languages |
| [Indonesian](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/indonesian/) | `id` | All languages |
| [Japanese](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/japanese/) | `ja` | All languages |
| [Korean](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/korean/) | `ko` | All languages |
| [Malay](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/malay/) | `ms` | All languages |
| [Persian (Farsi)](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/persian/) | `fa` | All languages |
| [Spanish](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/spanish/) | `es` | Parakeet v3 or All languages |
| [Tamil](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/tamil/) | `ta` | All languages |
| [Telugu](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/telugu/) | `te` | All languages |
| [Thai](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/thai/) | `th` | All languages |
| [Urdu](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/urdu/) | `ur` | All languages |
| [Vietnamese](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/vietnamese/) | `vi` | All languages |

 

## Auto or one to three pins

 

In Settings → Languages, use Auto or pin up to three languages. Enable automatic model choice to route those pins to a compatible installed model, or explicitly select a compatible model yourself. The controls do not start a download.

 

A single Whisper pin supplies its decoder language; multiple pins leave language detection enabled. Parakeet does not accept that same explicit decoder hint. Automatic model routing and language detection can be imperfect, especially for short, quiet or mixed-language speech. Review your results and language choice.

 

## One shared multilingual download

 

Arabic, Bengali, Chinese, Filipino / Tagalog, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Persian, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese use the shared All languages route. French, German, Portuguese and Spanish are also in Parakeet v3’s coverage. Installing another language choice reuses the model’s weights; there are no per-language download buttons.

 

See [model sizes and explicit setup](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/models/).

 

## Portuguese and Chinese details

 

Portuguese uses pt, including Brazil. The current automatic route is based on coverage, not a verified preference for every Brazilian accent. NVIDIA notes European Portuguese training in its original model card. Compare representative speech before choosing a model for your workflow.

 

Mandarin Chinese uses zh. Cantonese, yue, is a separate menu choice using the multilingual weights. The app does not expose a Simplified/Traditional conversion setting or establish coverage of every Chinese dialect.

 

## Coverage and measured accuracy

 

The public 20-language evaluation reveals substantial errors in Bengali, Tamil and Telugu. Larger decoder candidates have not established a general improvement. Broad owner accuracy remains deferred. Review names, numbers and technical terms before sending a draft; text cleanup does not prove that recognition was correct.

 

Dictation language, the Style preview language and experimental Translate output targets are separate choices. Current spoken Translate targets are English, Spanish and Arabic. See [styles and translation](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/styles/).

## A few useful answers.

### Does each language need a separate pack?

No. Multiple language choices reuse the same installed model. The optional All languages package is shared; choosing or pinning another language never starts a download.

### Is Brazilian Portuguese a separate model or decoder?

No. Portuguese uses pt in Parakeet and Whisper, including Brazilian Portuguese. There is no Brazil-only pt-BR decoder here; br means Breton. Accent-specific accuracy still needs evaluation.

## Sources and further reading

- [App language codes, routing and limits ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/LANGUAGES.md)

- [Measured multilingual accuracy scope ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/ASR_ACCURACY.md)

# Saydraft Local Models — Parakeet, Whisper and Cleanup

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/models/

Compare Saydraft's local speech and cleanup models, pinned download sizes, licenses, explicit setup, cached reuse and optional quiet-speech enhancement.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

## Speech and cleanup are separate stages

 

The speech model turns audio into words. Deterministic rules can format those words; an optional text model can make further edits within its time and preservation checks. Choosing an AI cleanup model does not replace the speech model, and better prose does not prove better recognition.

 

## Pick a compatible speech model

 

Fresh profiles recommend Parakeet v3 int8, with its disclosed tiny Whisper language detector. It recognizes 25 European languages, including English, French, German, Spanish and Portuguese. English max uses Parakeet v2.

 

All languages uses the shared Whisper large-v3-turbo model for the other supported language choices. Whisper base, small and medium are alternative local options. Use [language pins and model compatibility](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/languages/) to choose a route for the words you actually dictate.

 

| Speech model or package | Transfer | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Default: Parakeet v3 + language detector](https://huggingface.co/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8) | 773.4 MB | CC-BY-4.0 + MIT |
| [English max: Parakeet v2](https://huggingface.co/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2-int8) | 661.3 MB | CC-BY-4.0 |
| [Whisper base](https://huggingface.co/Systran/faster-whisper-base) | 147.9 MB | MIT |
| [Whisper small](https://huggingface.co/Systran/faster-whisper-small) | 486.2 MB | MIT |
| [Whisper medium](https://huggingface.co/Systran/faster-whisper-medium) | 1530.6 MB | MIT |
| [All languages: Whisper turbo](https://huggingface.co/dropbox-dash/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo) | 1621.7 MB | MIT |
| [Optional Silero speech detection](https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad/tree/v5.0) | 2.3 MB | MIT |
| [Optional GTCRN quiet-speech enhancement](https://github.com/Xiaobin-Rong/gtcrn) | 0.54 MB | MIT |

 

Sizes are calculated from the pinned catalog at build time, with dependency deduplication and bundled notices excluded from network transfer. MB means 1,000,000 bytes. Existing verified files and resumable partials can reduce the remaining transfer. Installed disk use and temporary space are separate.

 

## Install explicitly, then reuse offline

 

Setup shows the recommendation, complete package size, source and license before Download / Resume. Pause is available. Downloaded files are verified before they are ready, and later launches reuse the installed models offline. Choosing a language, enabling a feature or starting recognition does not fetch missing files.

 

Settings → Models provides installation/storage status and selected-model performance checks. Existing local Whisper paths have a compatibility route; a successful local load is distinct from catalog checksum verification.

 

## Optional AI cleanup and editing

 

Rules-only cleanup needs no text model. Optional Qwen cleanup weights and a compatible llama.cpp CPU or Vulkan runtime add separate transfers. Command, Translate and Ask share an experimental editing setup with a 4B model; downloading it does not enable any of those features or change ordinary speech settings.

 

| Optional model/runtime | Transfer | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Qwen3.5 0.8B cleanup](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Qwen_Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF) | 579.6 MB | Apache-2.0 |
| [Qwen3.5 2B cleanup](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Qwen_Qwen3.5-2B-GGUF) | 1396.2 MB | Apache-2.0 |
| [Qwen3.5 4B experimental editing](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Qwen_Qwen3.5-4B-GGUF) | 3013.0 MB | Apache-2.0 |
| [llama.cpp CPU runtime](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/tag/b12110) | 46.9 MB | MIT + LLVM OpenMP license notice |
| [llama.cpp Vulkan runtime](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/tag/b12110) | 88.9 MB | MIT + LLVM OpenMP license notice |

 

Runtime choice and model preparation affect latency and memory. A capability recommendation is provisional; an installed-model check is a measurement of that test workload, not a promise for every recording. Quality and release-latency qualification remain separate.

 

## Quiet speech and live preview

 

Settings → Microphone has an experimental, default-off Whisper mode for quiet speech: gain, AGC, a more sensitive speech-detection profile and optional local GTCRN enhancement. Its name does not select the Whisper ASR model. GTCRN setup is an explicit reviewed download; gain/AGC can be used without enhancement. The owner whispered-speech accuracy target is still unmeasured.

 

Live preview is another separate Labs model/setup choice. Its current model is English-specific. In quiet-speech mode, live partials keep their original signal while enhanced primary recognition supplies final text.

 

See [styles](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/styles/) for cleanup control and [credits](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/credits/) for the full attribution boundaries.

## A few useful answers.

### Is a larger download always better?

No. Compatibility, accuracy and speed depend on the language, recording and hardware. The larger decoder candidates have not established a universal improvement, and measured release-latency work remains open.

### Are Lite, Standard and Pro subscriptions?

No. They are local hardware/performance profiles in the free, open-source app. Experimental editing needs Pro and its explicitly installed model/runtime.

## Sources and further reading

- [Current model choices and setup behavior ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/MODELS.md)

- [Pinned artifact catalog ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/saydraft/models/manifest.json)

- [Hardware/performance checks ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/HARDWARE.md)

# Saydraft Notes — Local Scratchpad and Meeting Limits

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/notes/

Press F10 to record a local voice note, or write in Saydraft Scratchpad. Learn offline saving, note review and the separate limits of meeting notes.

Facts checked: 2026-11-17

## Record a voice note

 

Press F10 to start, wait for Recording note, then press F10 again to stop. You can also use Record note in Hub → Notes. Esc cancels; the usual recording time limit applies. Change Record note in Settings → Shortcuts; the global binding works while listening is enabled.

 

The result saves to Notes and History without reading or inserting into the foreground app. Your open Scratchpad stays unchanged. Speech models must be installed; optional AI cleanup uses your chosen local model. If saving to Notes fails, recover your words from History.

 

## Open Scratchpad

 

Press Win + Alt + S, or choose New note in Hub → Notes. Scratchpad is a resizable plain-text window. Opening it starts no recording. You can type without an AI model, or dictate into its focused field using the normal shortcut and compatible installed speech models.

 

## Save a draft locally

 

A draft saves after a short typing pause. Closing the window or moving between notes waits for pending edits. An untouched blank draft creates no note. Reopening Scratchpad resumes its last saved draft, including after a later app launch. The draft and saved notes stay in the local app data.

 

If saving fails, the window keeps your unsaved text and offers recovery. A revision conflict refuses to overwrite another edit; Save as new preserves your draft separately. Review any discard confirmation before dropping text.

 

## Review saved Notes

 

Hub → Notes provides search and plain-text review. Scratchpad, Command, Ask and meeting results are independent note origins. Creating a meeting Note does not replace the active Scratchpad. Notes browsing does not record, inspect another app or need a network connection.

 

Copy uses the app’s Windows clipboard privacy handling. Windows clipboard history or sync can have separate behavior; read the [privacy boundaries](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/privacy/) before copying sensitive text.

 

## Experimental meeting notes

 

Meeting notes are separate from ordinary Scratchpad. They require the Pro hardware profile, an explicit Labs opt-in, reviewed model downloads, selected inputs and participant permission. Enabling the feature or finishing a model download never starts recording.

 

The current source provides local recording/analysis controls and transcript review. Its complete live/frozen workflow, a 30-minute meeting and broad speech, speaker-label and summary accuracy are still unaccepted. Review names, decisions and task owners against the transcript. Do not treat generated notes as a verified record without that review.

 

See the linked implementation guide for current setup and recovery details, [model requirements](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/models/) for dependencies, and [shortcuts](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/shortcuts/) for rebinding.

## A few useful answers.

### What is the shortcut to record a voice note?

Press F10 to start and F10 again to stop while listening is enabled. The note saves locally in Notes and History without inserting into another app. You can change Record note in Settings → Shortcuts.

### Does opening Scratchpad start a recording?

No. Scratchpad is a local plain-text window. Type into it, or use your normal dictation shortcut while its field is focused. Dictation still needs compatible installed speech models.

### Are meeting notes fully qualified?

No. Meeting notes are an experimental Pro hardware-profile feature with explicit model setup, device selection and recording consent. Live and frozen workflows, a 30-minute meeting and broad speech, speaker and summary accuracy remain open acceptance work.

## Sources and further reading

- [Scratchpad, local saving and independent Notes ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/NOTES.md)

- [Experimental meeting setup and measured limits ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/MEETINGS.md)

# Verify Saydraft Offline — Network and Firewall Checks

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/privacy/verify-offline/

Check local Saydraft dictation without internet, understand its Python network guard, and review optional packaged Windows Firewall controls and limits.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

## Prepare while connected

 

Finish the explicit download and verification of your selected speech models. Install cleanup or experimental feature dependencies too if you plan to use them offline. Review [model requirements](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/models/) and keep optional update checking off if you do not want release requests.

 

## Try an ordinary offline draft

 

- Disconnect Wi-Fi or the network cable.
 
- Open Saydraft and an ordinary editable text field.
 
- Dictate a short sentence and review both the local History entry and delivery.
 
- Repeat with optional cleanup only if its model/runtime is already installed.

 

This manual check uses your microphone and chosen field only when you run it. Reconnecting should not be needed to reuse complete compatible local files. Missing files require a separate explicit setup action when connected.

 

## Inspect connections

 

Windows Resource Monitor can show process connections while you dictate. A local cleanup server may appear as a loopback connection. Read the [privacy page](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/privacy/) for explicit downloads, saved opt-in release checks, retained audio and clipboard boundaries.

 

The Python network guard restricts Python sockets and scoped download/update exceptions. It does not prove that every native library or separate process is blocked. Observing no traffic in a short session also does not prove every path.

 

## Optional packaged Firewall controls

 

For a local packaged installation, Settings → Privacy offers Block Saydraft from the internet. Review the executable path and download restriction, then approve the separate Windows administrator prompt if you choose to proceed. The operation takes effect separately from Settings Save. Cancelling leaves the rule unchanged. These controls are unavailable for a source Python process or a linked/remote installation.

 

Check firewall rules inspects matching enabled rules. A count is evidence of those rules, not proof that Firewall profiles are enabled or organizational policy applies them. Review effective policy in Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security. Keep organizational rules intact.

 

## Recheck downloads, cleanup and the path

 

A matching effective block should stop an explicit missing-model download with guidance to remove Saydraft’s block rule and resume. Installed speech files remain available. After Remove Saydraft’s block rule and Windows approval, retry the download explicitly; other connectivity or policy can still prevent it.

 

The rule covers native stacks within that `Saydraft.exe`, not separate helpers such as the cleanup sidecar. All-address rules can affect loopback on some policies, so check installed cleanup before relying on it. Moving a portable app changes the path covered by the rule. Review/remove its rule before moving or uninstalling; uninstall does not silently elevate to change OS policy.

 

The linked implementation record documents a narrow packaged speech/download test. It is separate from broad owner accuracy, physical dictation and complete cleanup-helper coverage.

## A few useful answers.

### Will a Firewall block stop setup downloads?

Yes, a matching effective block can prevent model downloads and update checks. Installed files remain local. Remove Saydraft's own block rule with Windows approval before explicitly resuming a download.

### Does Saydraft's rule cover every helper process?

No. The rule is tied to the packaged Saydraft.exe path. Separate executables such as the cleanup sidecar require their own effective-policy consideration. Moving the portable app changes the covered path.

## Sources and further reading

- [Offline verification, packaged rules and native scope ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/VERIFY_OFFLINE.md)

- [Python networking and explicit exceptions ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md)

# Saydraft Windows Shortcuts — Dictation and Hands-Free

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/shortcuts/

Learn Saydraft's hold-to-talk, F10 voice-note recording, hands-free, cancel, paste-last, Scratchpad and History shortcuts, with custom bindings.

Facts checked: 2026-11-17

## Everyday defaults

 

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Ctrl + Win | Hold to speak; release to finish |
| F9 | Alternate hold-to-speak shortcut |
| Ctrl + Win + Space | Toggle hands-free recording |
| Escape | Cancel the current recording or pending action |
| Shift + Alt + Z | Paste the last saved dictation |
| Win + Alt + S | Open Scratchpad |
| F10 | Start or stop a voice note; save to Notes and History |
| Ctrl + Win + D | Open the latest History diff |

 

The native app is still in development, including physical Windows shortcut acceptance. Start in an ordinary editable text field and review the result.

 

## Hold, toggle or double-tap

 

For a short draft, hold the dictation shortcut and release when finished. For hands-free use, toggle with Ctrl + Win + Space, then use the same toggle to stop. Double-tapping the same hold shortcut can also lock recording; its interval can be changed or disabled in Settings. A single short tap does not lock recording.

 

The default recording cap is twenty minutes, with a warning at nineteen minutes. Saved custom limits remain respected. Escape cancels; a very short accidental recording can be discarded rather than inserted.

 

## Change a binding

 

Use Settings → Shortcuts, or the Shortcut page during first-run setup. Learn shortcut captures keys only while setup stays focused and times out after ten seconds. Escape cancels learning. You can also enter a supported chord manually and check for conflicts before saving.

 

The app checks conflicts among its own shortcuts. The Wispr Flow advisory is separate and does not inventory every application’s shortcuts. Windows or an elevated app may reserve a combination; choose another binding if needed.

 

## Editing shortcuts are separate

 

Experimental Command Mode uses Ctrl + Win + Alt when enabled in Labs with the Pro profile and editing model. Hold it for an instruction and wait for the Command label before speaking. It does not use hands-free or double-tap behavior. See [Command Mode](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/command-mode/).

 

Paste-last is for saved dictations. It does not replay a selected-text Command or Ask result into a new field. Use the appropriate result’s explicit Copy action.

 

## If the destination changed

 

Delivery checks the target again. A changed, protected or elevated field may prevent insertion; use History to recover the saved words. Troubleshoot with [delivery and shortcut checks](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/troubleshooting/) rather than repeatedly triggering a recording in an unknown field.

## A few useful answers.

### Will an upgrade overwrite my custom shortcut?

Existing custom bindings are preserved. Settings provides conflict checks and explicit disable/reset choices; a conflicting new default is not silently forced onto an existing profile.

### Does paste-last run recognition again?

No. Shift + Alt + Z replays the last saved dictation through the guarded delivery path, without a new recording or cleanup request.

## Sources and further reading

- [Native shortcuts and current Windows acceptance scope ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/HOTKEYS.md)

- [Recording cap and warning behavior ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/RECORDING_LIMITS.md)

# Saydraft Styles — Tone and Local Dictation Cleanup

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/styles/

Choose Formal, Casual or Very casual tone per app, adjust cleanup intensity, preview dictionary edits and understand rules versus optional local AI.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

## Choose tone for the place you write

 

Hub → Style has seven app groups, three tones and four cleanup levels. Choose Formal, Casual or Very casual for a group, then save your staged changes. Per-app profiles can override the group’s choices. Code keeps its literal-oriented path instead of applying prose tone.

 

A recording keeps the style captured when it starts. Changing preferences while it runs does not change that recording’s style.

 

## Choose how much to tidy

 

| Level | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| 1 · Verbatim-ish | Preserve words, repetitions and spoken numbers; normalize spacing |
| 2 · Light | Remove hesitation fillers, normalize casing/numbers and allow supported list layout |
| 3 · Balanced | Also remove accidental repetition |
| 4 · Polished | Also handle stronger filler removal, explicit self-corrections and spoken punctuation |

 

Level one skips the prose model. At the other levels, optional AI remains subject to its preparation, time budget and preservation checks. Raw and Code have their own bypasses. A style choice does not make an unavailable AI model load or download.

 

## Preview before saving

 

Type a sample in the Style preview. The rules preview uses the same transcript processor as normal dictation, including staged Dictionary terms, replacements and supported snippets. Pending forms are previewed without saving them or creating persistent History. Invalid drafts show their error rather than an old result. The preview accepts up to 4,096 characters without silently truncating.

 

Preview language is independent of speech-model selection. Choose a language to simulate resolved recognition; use [Languages](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/languages/) for the real speech pins and model requirements.

 

## Rules and optional local AI

 

Rules work without a text model. Preview with current AI uses an already installed, prepared cleaner and its normal budget. Busy, warming, unavailable or rejected AI keeps a labelled rules result. Apply model-setting changes before trying the current-AI preview.

 

Cleanup can still be imperfect. It does not establish that the recognizer heard every name, number or word correctly. Compare raw and cleaned text in History, and keep [names and specialist terms](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/dictionary/) in your dictionary where useful.

 

## Translation is an independent choice

 

Translate while speaking is a separate Pro/Labs feature with an explicitly installed editing model and an output target per supported non-code app group. Current targets are English, Spanish and Arabic, or Keep recognized language. The text-cleanup preview does not run spoken translation. Raw and Code bypass it.

## A few useful answers.

### Does changing preview language change speech recognition?

No. Preview language simulates the recognizer's resolved language for text cleanup. It does not change speech-language pins, download a model or translate the sample.

### Does a rejected AI edit lose my transcript?

The cleanup path retains its rules result when the model is unavailable, out of budget or rejected by preservation checks. Review the raw and cleaned words in History.

## Sources and further reading

- [Shared styles engine and Hub preview ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/STYLES.md)

- [Cleanup preservation checks ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/VALIDATOR_V2.md)

# Saydraft Troubleshooting — Input, Models and Delivery

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/troubleshooting/

Troubleshoot Saydraft microphone input, interrupted model downloads, wrong language, slow cleanup, shortcut conflicts and text delivery on Windows.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

## The microphone meter does not respond

 

Open Microphone in setup or Settings. Check the selected device, use Refresh inputs if it changed, and run the level-only Test input. Check microphone privacy reads Windows permission state without recording; follow its Windows settings link if desktop-app microphone access is blocked or unknown.

 

Start with a short practice sentence. Source setup and physical Windows behavior remain in development. The [setup guide](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/getting-started/) describes practice and its stop/recovery choices.

 

## A download stopped or files are not ready

 

Use the same model’s Download / Resume action. Setup checks pinned files before marking the package ready; partial transfers can resume, and complete verified files are reused. Check available disk space and the network message.

 

If you enabled a packaged Firewall block, review [its download restriction](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/privacy/verify-offline/) and explicitly remove Saydraft’s own rule before resuming. Keep unrelated and organizational rules intact. Recognition and language selection do not fetch missing weights in the background.

 

## The words or language are wrong

 

Compare raw and cleaned text in History: raw text shows recognized words; cleaned text shows what formatting or cleanup changed. Check the recording conditions, selected speech model and [language pins](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/languages/).

 

Use a compatible model for your language. The shared All languages route is needed for Arabic, Bengali, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai and other supported languages outside Parakeet’s set. Dictionaries can help within their supported scope, but neither a larger model nor cleanup guarantees correct recognition. Review [names and replacements](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/dictionary/).

 

## Recognition or cleanup feels slow

 

Check model performance with the installed model and bundled audio. A provisional PC recommendation is separate from a timed model check. First preparation, hardware, recording length and model size affect delay; broader release-latency qualification remains open.

 

Rules-only cleanup works without a text model. Optional AI that is unavailable, unprepared, out of budget or rejected by preservation checks can keep the rules result. Review [styles and cleanup](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/styles/) before treating that fallback as a failure.

 

## The shortcut or paste did not work

 

Review [shortcut bindings and conflicts](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/shortcuts/). Start in an ordinary, non-elevated editable text field. Password, protected, changed and some elevated targets can prevent delivery. A saved result remains in History; use its explicit recovery actions rather than forcing a changed field.

 

A recognition retry requires the row’s retained audio. Without it, recover the saved text or make a new recording. Experimental Command results have their own Copy path and do not use ordinary dictation paste-last.

 

## Report a reproducible problem

 

Include your source/version, Windows version, selected model, language choice, and the smallest steps that reproduce the issue in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/issues). Use redacted logs and examples. Keep private recordings, transcripts, passwords and document text out of public reports.

## A few useful answers.

### The model is missing. Should I keep recording?

Finish the explicit model setup and verification first. Recognition never downloads missing weights automatically, and a changed or incomplete installation can refuse preparation.

### Can I retry recognition from a History row?

A History recognition retry needs retained audio. Audio retention is off by default. Without the row's audio, recover its saved text or make a new recording.

## Sources and further reading

- [Current troubleshooting and supported source launch ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/readme.md)

- [Microphone and permission behavior ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/MICROPHONE.md)

- [Delivery, protected fields and recovery ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/DELIVERY.md)

# Get Saydraft for Windows — Download and Setup

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/download/

Download the free Saydraft Windows x64 portable preview. Review the unsigned ZIP, SHA-256 checksum, setup instructions and local speech model sizes.

Facts checked: 2026-11-17

Saydraft is in development. The current Windows preview is available as an unsigned portable ZIP. Models are installed separately during setup.

 

## Saydraft for Windows

0.1.1 · Windows x64 · 157.3 MB

Unsigned development preview · portable ZIP. Extract the whole folder and run Saydraft.exe. Speech models are downloaded explicitly during setup.

## Start the portable app

 

- Quit an older Saydraft instance from its system-tray menu.
 
- Download the ZIP and extract the whole folder to a location you can write to.
 
- Run Saydraft.exe on Windows 10 or 11 x64. The portable includes its Python runtime.
 
- Choose your microphone, review and install a speech model, then try the private setup practice.

 

Keep all extracted support files together. The preview has no installer; optional AI cleanup is available in the Models setup step and can be left off to use rules.

 

## Set up once. Then go offline.

 

Review the recommended model, size and license, then start its download in setup. Progress and pause/resume are available. Later launches reuse your installed files. The [setup walkthrough](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/getting-started/) covers microphone selection, models, shortcuts and a first practice draft.

 

Arabic, Bengali, Chinese, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Thai and Urdu use the optional shared All languages model. Download it once; there are no separate language packs. Portuguese, including Brazilian Portuguese, is also covered by the default model. Review [language and model choices](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/languages/) before choosing a package.

 

## Speech model downloads

 

These transfer sizes come from the pinned app catalog at build time. MB means 1,000,000 bytes. Verified cache entries can reduce what you download; disk use also includes installed files, temporary transfers and optional retained audio.

 

| Model or package | Transfer | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Default: Parakeet v3 + language detector](https://huggingface.co/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8) | 773.4 MB | CC-BY-4.0 + MIT |
| [English max: Parakeet v2](https://huggingface.co/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2-int8) | 661.3 MB | CC-BY-4.0 |
| [Whisper base](https://huggingface.co/Systran/faster-whisper-base) | 147.9 MB | MIT |
| [Whisper small](https://huggingface.co/Systran/faster-whisper-small) | 486.2 MB | MIT |
| [Whisper medium](https://huggingface.co/Systran/faster-whisper-medium) | 1530.6 MB | MIT |
| [All languages: Whisper turbo](https://huggingface.co/dropbox-dash/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo) | 1621.7 MB | MIT |
| [Optional Silero speech detection](https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad/tree/v5.0) | 2.3 MB | MIT |
| [Optional GTCRN quiet-speech enhancement](https://github.com/Xiaobin-Rong/gtcrn) | 0.54 MB | MIT |

 

The default package includes its language detector. Optional AI cleanup, live preview and editing features have separate model/runtime requirements. See [local models](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/models/) for those choices and their limits. Selecting a language never starts a transfer.

 

## Run from source

 

For development, you’ll need Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit Python 3.13, Git, a microphone and disk space for your selected models. In PowerShell:

 PowerShell

```
git clone https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft.git
cd saydraft
py -3.13 -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
.venv\Scripts\python -m saydraft
```

 

The repository can move ahead of the published preview. Check the release’s source commit and SHA-256 before comparing builds. There is no winget or Scoop command for this portable preview.

## A few useful answers.

### Is a signed Windows installer available here?

This build is an unsigned Windows x64 portable ZIP. Extract the whole folder and run Saydraft.exe. Windows may show an unknown-publisher or SmartScreen prompt. No signed installer or package-manager command is provided for this preview.

### Will models download automatically?

No. Setup shows the recommendation, size and license before you choose Download / Resume. You can pause; later launches reuse verified installed files.

# Free Dragon Alternative for Windows | Saydraft

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/dragon-alternative/

Explore Saydraft as a free, open-source Dragon alternative for Windows writing. Compare local recognition, scope, licensing and setup requirements.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

Saydraft is a free, MIT-licensed project for local Windows dictation. Consider it for drafting messages, notes and documents when you want inspectable source and local models. A stable public release and broader workflow qualification are still pending.

 

Dragon Professional v16 is a commercial Windows application with a broader established dictation and command workflow. Its [data sheet](https://dragon.nuance.com/shared/data-sheets/ds-dragon-professional-v16-en-us.pdf) describes local desktop recognition and internet requirements for download and automatic activation. Keep it separate from Dragon Professional Anywhere, which is a different product.

 

## Compare the scope

 

| Choice | Saydraft | Dragon Professional v16 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Recognition | [Local speech models](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/MODELS.md) | [Desktop recognition](https://dragon.nuance.com/shared/data-sheets/ds-dragon-professional-v16-en-us.pdf) |
| License | [MIT-licensed app source](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/LICENSE) | [Commercial licensed software](https://dragon.nuance.com/en-us/dragon-professional) |
| Main focus | [Writing and local text workflows](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft) | [Professional dictation and commands](https://dragon.nuance.com/en-us/dragon-professional) |
| Cost | [Free source](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft) | [Contact the vendor for current pricing](https://dragon.nuance.com/en-us/dragon-professional) |

 

The current official Dragon page directs buyers to sales. Confirm current pricing and the license plan that fits your workflow with the vendor.

 

## Evaluate with your own documents

 

If your workflow depends on application control, specialist vocabulary or an accessibility command system, test those requirements explicitly before changing tools. Saydraft has not completed broad physical or accessibility acceptance. Dictation can reduce the amount of keyboard input needed for a writing task.

 

Start with [setup](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/getting-started/) and the [offline dictation guide](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/offline-dictation-windows/). Compare representative names, numbers and long passages rather than assuming that one model’s result predicts another’s.

 

Not affiliated with Dragon or Nuance. Information checked on the date above.

## A few useful answers.

### Is Dragon Professional a cloud-only product?

Dragon Professional v16 for Windows has local desktop recognition. Its data sheet specifies internet for download and automatic activation. Dragon Professional Anywhere is a separate cloud product.

### Does Saydraft replace Dragon's full command system?

Saydraft focuses on voice typing, formatting and experimental text editing. It does not claim equivalent application control, specialist workflows or accessibility qualification.

07 — Questions

## Glad you asked.

Still curious? Read the docs or open an issue on GitHub — the whole project is in the open.

[Read the docs ↗](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/)[GitHub issues ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/issues)

### Does my voice leave my PC?

Speech recognition and text cleanup run locally. Saydraft has no cloud transcription, telemetry, or account. Model downloads happen only when you start them during setup. Optional update checks are off by default and request public release information from GitHub without your audio or text.

### Do I need the internet to get started?

Yes, once: choose the recommended models, review their sizes and licenses, and start the setup download. You can pause and resume. Later launches reuse the installed models offline.

### Which languages can I dictate in?

Highlighted choices are Arabic, Bengali, Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese (Mandarin), Filipino / Tagalog, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Persian (Farsi), Spanish, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Urdu, Vietnamese. Parakeet v3 covers 25 European languages; the other highlighted choices use the optional shared All languages model. There are no separate language packs. Choosing a language starts no download.

### Do I need a powerful graphics card?

Speech recognition can run on the CPU. Hardware and model choice affect speed; optional AI cleanup requires more resources. The performance check helps choose a suitable setup, including rules-only cleanup.

### Where can I use it?

Saydraft inserts text at the cursor in editable Windows apps. Password fields are excluded. Some protected or elevated apps need extra care; start with an ordinary text editor.

### Can I change how my words are cleaned up?

Choose a tone and cleanup intensity for each app group, add names to your dictionary, and create spoken snippets. Raw mode preserves your transcript without prose cleanup.

### Is it free?

Saydraft is free and open source under the MIT license. Speech and cleanup models have their own licenses, shown before download and listed in the project credits.

### Is this page listening to me?

No. The example is a canned simulation. This website does not request microphone access, upload audio, or use tracking analytics.

### Is there a subscription word quota?

No. Saydraft has no subscription word quota. Each dictation has a configurable recording cap, 20 minutes by default, with a warning at 19 minutes. That duration cap is separate from the words you can dictate across sessions.

### Can it make meeting notes?

Meeting notes are an experimental Pro hardware-profile feature with explicit model setup, device selection and recording consent. Full live/frozen workflows, a 30-minute meeting and broader speech, speaker and summary accuracy remain open acceptance work. Ordinary Scratchpad notes are separate.

Make room for your next thought

## Less keyboard. More possibility.

# Arabic Voice Typing for Windows, Offline | Saydraft

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/arabic/

Dictate Arabic offline on Windows with Saydraft. Free, open-source Arabic voice typing through a shared local multilingual speech model.

Free, open-source dictation

# Arabic voice typing for Windows.

العربية

Turn spoken Arabic into text on your Windows PC while keeping speech recognition local. Saydraft uses the installed All languages model for Arabic dictation, with no cloud transcription account.

Choose Arabic, language code ar, in Languages. Pin Arabic alone for a direct recognition hint, or pin it alongside English or another language for model language detection. The current choice does not expose a separate decoder for every Arabic dialect.

Requires the shared All languages speech model (Whisper large-v3-turbo, approximately 1,621.7 MB). Download once in setup or Models, then reuse it offline.

## How to set up Arabic dictation

- Follow the [current download and source setup instructions](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/download/). Saydraft is a development preview for Windows 10 and 11.

- In Hub → Settings → Models, review the required model’s size and license. Choose Download / Resume if it is missing; Pause is available.

- Open Languages, enable automatic model choice, and select Arabic. Save your settings. A single language pin uses code `ar`.

- Put the cursor in an editable app field, hold Ctrl + Win, speak, then release. Review the transcript before sending it.

Language selection starts no transfer. If automatic routing is off, the model selected on Models remains in use; select a compatible model there. For more detail, see the [setup guide](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/getting-started/).

## Use your voice in everyday Windows apps

Draft Arabic messages, notes and documents in an editable app that supports right-to-left text. Review spelling, names, numbers, punctuation and mixed Arabic/Latin text before sending. Dialect and recording conditions affect recognition; Raw mode keeps the recognized wording without prose cleanup.

Speech recognition and text cleanup run locally. There is no account or cloud transcription fallback. With compatible models installed, you can dictate without an internet connection. Optional AI cleanup has its own model requirements; rules-only cleanup needs no text model.

## Is Arabic dictation the same as translating into Arabic?

Arabic dictation transcribes Arabic speech using All languages. The separate experimental Pro/Labs Translate mode can produce Arabic from recognized speech using its explicitly installed local editing model. You do not need Translate mode or a separate Arabic language pack to dictate Arabic.

## What does language support mean here?

This page describes speech-model coverage and app configuration. It does not claim a measured accuracy score for Arabic. Accent, microphone, background noise and mixed speech affect results. The language choice does not translate the app interface or add Translate-mode output targets.

[Get Saydraft for Windows](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/download/) · [See how dictation stays local](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/privacy/)
