# Bengali Voice Typing for Windows, Offline | Saydraft

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/bengali/

Type Bangla with your voice on Windows. Saydraft offers free, open-source offline Bengali speech recognition through a shared local model.

Free, open-source dictation

# Bengali voice typing for Windows.

বাংলা

Write in Bengali, also called Bangla, with your voice on Windows. Saydraft recognizes Bengali speech locally using the shared All languages model, without a cloud transcription account.

Choose Bengali, language code bn, in Languages. Pin Bengali alone for a direct recognition hint, or combine it with English or another language when you switch between them. Bengali is already supported by the shared multilingual model; there is no separate Bangla language pack.

Requires the shared All languages speech model (Whisper large-v3-turbo, approximately 1,621.7 MB). Download once in setup or Models, then reuse it offline.

## How to set up Bengali dictation

- Follow the [current download and source setup instructions](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/download/). Saydraft is a development preview for Windows 10 and 11.

- In Hub → Settings → Models, review the required model’s size and license. Choose Download / Resume if it is missing; Pause is available.

- Open Languages, enable automatic model choice, and select Bengali. Save your settings. A single language pin uses code `bn`.

- Put the cursor in an editable app field, hold Ctrl + Win, speak, then release. Review the transcript before sending it.

Language selection starts no transfer. If automatic routing is off, the model selected on Models remains in use; select a compatible model there. For more detail, see the [setup guide](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/getting-started/).

## Use your voice in everyday Windows apps

Draft Bengali messages, emails and notes in an editable Windows app. Review spelling, conjuncts, names, numbers and English loanwords before sending. Raw mode retains the recognized wording without prose cleanup. The language choice does not add a Romanized-Bangla conversion setting.

Speech recognition and text cleanup run locally. There is no account or cloud transcription fallback. With compatible models installed, you can dictate without an internet connection. Optional AI cleanup has its own model requirements; rules-only cleanup needs no text model.

## Do I need a separate Bengali model or keyboard?

Install the shared All languages model once through Download / Resume. It covers Bengali alongside Arabic and other supported languages. A Bengali keyboard can help with manual corrections, but dictation delivers Unicode text and does not depend on choosing that keyboard layout. Selecting Bengali starts no download.

## What does language support mean here?

This page describes speech-model coverage and app configuration. It does not claim a measured accuracy score for Bengali. Accent, microphone, background noise and mixed speech affect results. The language choice does not translate the app interface or add Translate-mode output targets.

[Get Saydraft for Windows](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/download/) · [See how dictation stays local](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/privacy/)

# Brazilian Portuguese Voice Typing for Windows | Saydraft

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/brazilian-portuguese/

Offline Brazilian Portuguese voice typing on Windows. Saydraft is free and open source, with local Portuguese speech recognition and no account.

Free, open-source dictation

# Brazilian Portuguese voice typing for Windows.

Português do Brasil

Write in Portuguese with your voice, including Portuguese spoken in Brazil. Saydraft provides local speech recognition for Windows without an account or cloud transcription.

In Languages, choose Portuguese (including Brazilian Portuguese). The speech engines use the shared Portuguese code pt. There is no Brazil-only model or pt-BR decoder setting. Do not choose br for Brazil: in Whisper, br is the code for Breton.

Portuguese, including Brazil, is included in Parakeet v3, the default speech model. All languages is also compatible. No separate language pack is required.

## How to set up Brazilian Portuguese dictation

- Follow the [current download and source setup instructions](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/download/). Saydraft is a development preview for Windows 10 and 11.

- In Hub → Settings → Models, review the required model’s size and license. Choose Download / Resume if it is missing; Pause is available.

- Open Languages, enable automatic model choice, and select Portuguese (including Brazilian Portuguese). Save your settings. A single language pin uses code `pt`.

- Put the cursor in an editable app field, hold Ctrl + Win, speak, then release. Review the transcript before sending it.

Language selection starts no transfer. If automatic routing is off, the model selected on Models remains in use; select a compatible model there. For more detail, see the [setup guide](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/getting-started/).

## Use your voice in everyday Windows apps

Portuguese is included in the default Parakeet v3 model’s language set. You can also use Portuguese with All languages. If you pin Portuguese alongside Thai, Chinese or Korean, automatic routing uses that shared multilingual model for the combination.

Speech recognition and text cleanup run locally. There is no account or cloud transcription fallback. With compatible models installed, you can dictate without an internet connection. Optional AI cleanup has its own model requirements; rules-only cleanup needs no text model.

## Is there a separate Brazilian Portuguese language pack?

No. Choose Portuguese in Languages and use an installed compatible speech model. Both the default model and All languages cover Portuguese. NVIDIA notes that Parakeet’s training uses European Portuguese, so a separate Brazilian reference evaluation is needed before recommending it over Whisper for Brazil. Saydraft does not claim a separate Brazilian-accent accuracy score or convert European Portuguese wording into Brazilian Portuguese.

## What does language support mean here?

This page describes speech-model coverage and app configuration. It does not claim a measured accuracy score for Brazilian Portuguese. Accent, microphone, background noise and mixed speech affect results. The language choice does not translate the app interface or add Translate-mode output targets.

[Get Saydraft for Windows](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/download/) · [See how dictation stays local](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/privacy/)

Speech recognition and text cleanup run locally. There is no account or cloud transcription fallback. With compatible models installed, you can dictate without an internet connection. Optional AI cleanup has its own model requirements; rules-only cleanup needs no text model.

## Can I choose Simplified or Traditional Chinese output?

Saydraft currently exposes the model’s language choice, rather than a separate Chinese script converter. Its Chinese setting uses zh. If your document requires a particular script, review and convert the result with a tool you trust.

# Offline voice typing. In your language.

Saydraft supports multilingual dictation on Windows through local speech models. Thai, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Hindi, Urdu, Indonesian, Malay, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Bengali and Arabic are among the available language choices. Use the shared All languages model.

## One model can cover many languages

The optional All languages model is Whisper large-v3-turbo. A single approximately 1,621.7 MB installation covers Thai, Mandarin Chinese, Korean, Bengali, Arabic and other supported Whisper languages, including Japanese, Hindi, Urdu, Vietnamese, Filipino / Tagalog, Tamil, Telugu, Persian, Indonesian and Malay. There are no separate language packs.

The default Parakeet v3 model covers 25 European languages, including Spanish, French, German and Portuguese. Brazilian Portuguese uses the Portuguese choice, code `pt`; there is no separate Brazil-only decoder setting.

## Choose your language before you dictate

- In Hub → Settings → Models, review and explicitly download a compatible speech model.

- In Languages, enable automatic model choice, then pin one to three languages. One Whisper pin supplies a language hint; multiple pins leave model language detection enabled.

- Save your settings, open an editable field and use your dictation shortcut. Later launches reuse the installed models offline.

Selecting a language starts no download. If you keep manual model selection enabled, choose a compatible model yourself. For direct languages outside Parakeet’s set, pin the language with automatic routing or manually choose All languages.

## Dictation and translation are separate

These are speech recognition choices: speak a language and receive its transcript. They are not translated app menus or additional Translate-mode output targets. Recognition quality varies with accent, audio and model; language coverage is not an accuracy guarantee. Review your text, especially names and mixed-language speech.

You can pin up to three languages. With Korean and English pinned, the router chooses All languages and lets that model detect the language. Recognition of short or mixed speech can vary, so review names and English terms in the result.

## What does language support mean here?

This page describes speech-model coverage and app configuration. It does not claim a measured accuracy score for Korean. Accent, microphone, background noise and mixed speech affect results. The language choice does not translate the app interface or add Translate-mode output targets.

# Offline Dictation for Windows: A Practical Guide | Saydraft

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/offline-dictation-windows/

Learn how offline dictation works on Windows: speech models, hardware, languages, local cleanup and privacy. A practical free, open-source setup guide.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

Offline dictation turns microphone audio into text with a model stored on your computer. An optional second model can tidy the wording. Recognition and optional cleanup run on your PC and need memory, processor time, storage and careful review.

 

Saydraft is a free, open-source Windows project built around this workflow. An unsigned portable preview is available from the [download page](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/download/), with source setup also available. Broader accuracy and native Windows acceptance remain in progress.

 

## What runs on your PC

 

Speech recognition produces the transcript. Deterministic rules can format it; optional local AI cleanup can make further edits when its quality and time guards allow. These are separate stages. Improving prose after recognition does not establish that the original names, numbers or words were heard correctly.

 

Raw and Code modes reduce prose processing. Keep them available for material where literal wording matters.

 

## Choose a compatible language model

 

The default Parakeet v3 choice covers 25 European languages. The optional shared All languages model is Whisper large-v3-turbo and covers the other supported Whisper language choices. Thai, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Hindi, Urdu, Bengali and Arabic use that shared multilingual route.

 

With automatic model choice enabled, pin one to three languages. A single Whisper pin supplies its decoder language; multiple pins leave model language detection enabled. Parakeet does not accept that explicit decoder hint. Review the [language and model guide](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/); coverage does not guarantee accuracy for every accent, dialect or mixed-language passage.

 

## Plan for storage and hardware

 

The default speech bundle is approximately 773.4 MB including its language detector. All languages is approximately 1,621.7 MB. Optional editing models add their own downloads and memory needs. Setup shows the files, sizes and licenses before you explicitly choose Download / Resume.

 

Use the application’s model performance check to measure an installed model with bundled audio. It makes a provisional capability recommendation rather than a guarantee of everyday speed. Larger models and longer passages can add delay; broad release-latency qualification remains in progress.

 

## Check privacy as a workflow

 

Installed speech and cleanup run locally. Model downloads and optional update checks are separate network actions. History is local, audio retention is off by default, and your PC still controls who can access saved data.

 

Finish setup, disconnect your network and try a plain text editor. Read the [privacy page](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/privacy/) and the linked verification guide for details of the network guard and optional Windows Firewall controls. The website itself has no microphone access or tracking analytics.

 

## Test the words you actually use

 

Try quiet speech, proper names, numbers and a longer paragraph. Review all results before sending them elsewhere. The public 20-language baseline exposes substantial Bengali, Tamil and Telugu errors, and broad owner accuracy remains deferred. Experimental decoder candidates are kept out when they regress.

 

Start with the [setup guide](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/getting-started/). For editor and terminal workflows, continue with [dictation for developers](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/dictation-for-developers/).

## A few useful answers.

### Does offline dictation need internet during use?

Installed local models can recognize speech without internet. Saydraft's setup downloads are explicit, and optional GitHub update checks are off by default. Finish model setup before disconnecting.

### Does every language need its own download?

No. The shared multilingual speech model covers many language choices. Selecting or pinning a language does not start a download.

### Will a larger model always be more accurate?

No. Recognition varies by language, recording conditions and model. Compare measured results and your own representative speech; larger downloads alone do not establish better accuracy or speed.

## Sources and further reading

- [Saydraft models and measurement scope ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/MODELS.md)

- [Multilingual accuracy findings ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/ASR_ACCURACY.md)

- [Offline verification and its limits ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/VERIFY_OFFLINE.md)


---

# Saydraft Privacy — What Stays on Your PC

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/privacy/

How Saydraft handles local speech, explicit downloads, optional update checks, History, audio retention and a website without tracking analytics.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

## Speech and cleanup stay local

 

The app runs speech recognition and optional AI cleanup on your PC. There is no cloud transcription or account, and no telemetry or crash uploads. The Python network guard blocks external connections except for scoped explicit model downloads and saved opt-in update checks. The cleanup server uses loopback on your own machine.

 

Python policy does not control every native library or separate executable. The [offline verification guide](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/privacy/verify-offline/) explains optional packaged Windows Firewall controls and their limits.

 

## Downloads are explicit

 

Models and runtimes download only when you start their setup action. Sizes, sources and licenses are shown first; pinned files are checked with SHA-256. Installed models are reused offline. Choosing a language or enabling a Labs option does not start a download.

 

## Update checks are your choice

 

Update checking is off by default. Enable it in Settings → Privacy to request public GitHub release information at startup and every 24 hours while the app runs, or choose Check now. The request includes the app version, without your audio, transcripts, field text, clipboard contents, History or device data.

 

You download and install updates yourself. Saydraft does not fetch installers or replace itself. Turn the setting off and save to stop future checks. A release page opens only after your action.

 

## History, recordings and correction learning

 

Dictations are saved locally in History before delivery. Review, export or delete entries there. Audio retention is off by default and is a separate choice. Local storage is still subject to your Windows account, backups and other software on the PC; “local” does not mean other software cannot access it.

 

Dictionary correction suggestions and Auto-add are separate, default-off choices. Learning can inspect the original editable field for a correction after a dictation. See [Dictionary](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/dictionary/) before enabling it. Password fields are excluded.

 

## Clipboard and selected text

 

Normal delivery and explicit Copy use the Windows clipboard boundary. Command Mode can additionally use a separate, default-off Ctrl+C fallback for selections that an app cannot expose through accessibility APIs. Windows and target-app clipboard history/sync settings apply; restoring the current clipboard does not remove copies already retained or synced by those systems.

 

Command and Ask operate only when explicitly enabled and invoked. Review [selection editing](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/command-mode/) for the difference between replacement and a result offered for Copy.

 

## This website

 

This site has no tracking analytics, advertising or microphone access. Fonts and scripts are self-hosted, and examples are canned simulations. Following an external link takes you to another service. GitHub Pages hosts the site and may process request information under [GitHub’s privacy statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

## A few useful answers.

### Does Saydraft upload recordings or transcripts?

Speech recognition and optional cleanup run locally. Saydraft has no cloud transcription, telemetry or crash uploads. Explicit downloads and saved opt-in release checks are separate network actions.

### Does restoring the clipboard remove Windows clipboard history?

No. Windows and target-app clipboard history or sync settings can apply, especially to Command Mode's separate optional Ctrl+C fallback. Restoring the current clipboard cannot retract those entries.

## Sources and further reading

- [Application networking and clipboard boundaries ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md)

- [Optional update checks ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/UPDATES.md)

- [Windows Firewall verification and limits ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/VERIFY_OFFLINE.md)

# Superwhisper Alternative for Windows | Saydraft

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/superwhisper-alternative-windows/

Compare Saydraft and Superwhisper for Windows voice typing. Review offline model choices, open-source licensing, paid plans and current setup status.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

Superwhisper is already available on Windows. It also supports macOS and now has an official Linux release. Choosing Saydraft is a decision about licensing, model workflow and project maturity, rather than access to a Windows app.

 

Both projects can use local speech models. Superwhisper also provides cloud choices, so its network behavior depends on the selected model and processing mode. Its [introduction](https://superwhisper.com/docs/get-started/introduction) explains the distinction, including supported local AI processing.

 

## Compare what you would install

 

| Choice | Saydraft | Superwhisper |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Local speech | [Installed Parakeet/Whisper models](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/MODELS.md) | [Local voice models](https://superwhisper.com/docs/get-started/introduction) |
| App license | [MIT-licensed source](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/LICENSE) | [Commercial application terms](https://superwhisper.com/terms) |
| Desktop availability | [Windows development project](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft) | [Windows and macOS](https://superwhisper.com/download), [Linux](https://superwhisper.com/linux) |
| Cost | [Free](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft) | [Free local dictation; paid Pro options](https://superwhisper.com/docs/billing/plans) |

 

Superwhisper’s website lists Pro at US$8.49 monthly, US$84.99 yearly or US$249.99 once. Store prices and current terms can differ; use the vendor’s plan page when making a purchase decision. Saydraft’s source has no subscription or paid unlock.

 

## Choosing a workflow

 

Try the same representative phrases in the models you plan to use. A local model can trade memory, speed and recognition quality differently from another local model. Neither shared use of Whisper nor a larger file establishes equal accuracy or performance.

 

Saydraft’s [offline guide](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/offline-dictation-windows/) explains explicit setup, hardware and privacy limits. Its public accuracy record includes substantial errors in some languages; broader acceptance is ongoing. Current source builds and experimental features need review before reliance in an everyday workflow.

 

Not affiliated with Superwhisper. Information checked on the date above.

## A few useful answers.

### Is Superwhisper available on Windows?

Yes. Superwhisper currently offers Windows and macOS downloads, and also has a Linux product and release. Saydraft is a separate Windows project.

### Are both applications capable of offline transcription?

Both offer local speech recognition. Superwhisper also offers cloud models; its offline AI processing depends on the selected local model and mode. Saydraft runs installed speech and optional editing models locally.

# Typeless Alternative for Windows, Offline | Saydraft

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/typeless-alternative/

Explore a free, open-source Typeless alternative for Windows. Compare local dictation, cloud processing, pricing and experimental editing features.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

Saydraft is a free, MIT-licensed Windows project for voice typing with local models. It is worth evaluating when offline use and inspectable application source matter to your workflow. An unsigned Windows portable preview is available from the [download page](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/download/); source setup is also available. A stable release and broader native acceptance remain pending.

 

Typeless currently offers desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux. Its [data controls](https://www.typeless.com/data-controls) describe processing on cloud servers. This comparison concerns where dictation runs, rather than a claim that one app recognizes speech more accurately.

 

## Compare the essentials

 

| Choice | Saydraft | Typeless |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Recognition | [Local speech models](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/MODELS.md) | [Cloud processing](https://www.typeless.com/data-controls) |
| Desktop platform | [Windows](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft) | [macOS, Windows and Linux](https://www.typeless.com/) |
| Software source | [MIT-licensed application](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/LICENSE) | [Commercial application terms](https://www.typeless.com/terms) |
| Pricing | [No subscription](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft) | [Free allowance; paid Pro and Enterprise](https://www.typeless.com/pricing) |

 

Typeless lists Pro at US$30 per member monthly, or US$12 per member per month when billed yearly. Its free plan includes a weekly word allowance. Verify current limits and billing terms with the vendor before choosing a plan.

 

## Dictation, cleanup and local editing

 

Saydraft combines recognized speech with deterministic formatting and optional local AI cleanup. Raw and Code modes are available when you want less prose editing. Names, numbers and meaningful wording still need review.

 

Experimental Translate and Ask use an explicitly installed local editing model. Ask opens an answer in a separate note; it does not browse the web. Translate currently has a narrower tested target set than ordinary multilingual dictation. These features are not a promise of identical Typeless behavior or equivalent quality in every language.

 

Start with [setup](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/getting-started/), then check [language and model coverage](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/). Existing models are reused offline, and choosing a language starts no download.

 

Not affiliated with Typeless. Information checked on the date above.

## A few useful answers.

### Does Typeless offer offline dictation?

Typeless documents an internet requirement for its cloud transcription and contextual processing. Saydraft uses installed local speech and editing models.

### Does Saydraft include translation and questions about text?

Experimental Pro/Labs Translate and Ask features are implemented with a separately installed shared local editing model. They require review, and broader quality and physical workflow acceptance remain open.

- [Typeless data controls ↗](https://www.typeless.com/data-controls)

- [Typeless pricing ↗](https://www.typeless.com/pricing)

- [Typeless application terms ↗](https://www.typeless.com/terms)

- [Saydraft source and status ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft)

# Windows Voice Typing Alternative, Offline | Saydraft

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/windows-voice-typing-alternative/

Compare Win+H voice typing with Saydraft's local Windows dictation. Understand internet requirements, Voice Access and explicit model setup.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

Win+H opens Windows voice typing. Microsoft documents an internet requirement for that feature and says it uses online speech recognition. Saydraft provides a separate route: install local speech models, then dictate on your PC while offline.

 

## Keep Windows features distinct

 

Windows voice typing and Windows Voice Access are different products. Microsoft documents [Voice Access](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accessibility/windows/voice-access/set-up-voice-access) as an accessibility feature that can use offline recognition after setup. Windows editions, languages, hardware and newer Copilot+ features can affect the options available on a particular PC.

 

Saydraft is primarily a writing tool. It does not promise full system navigation, mouse control or an equivalent accessibility command set.

 

| Choice | Saydraft | Standard Windows voice typing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Recognition | [Installed local models](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/MODELS.md) | [Online speech recognition](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accessibility/windows/use-voice-typing-to-talk-instead-of-type-on-your-pc) |
| Getting started | [Source setup and model download](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft) | [Win+H in a text field](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accessibility/windows/use-voice-typing-to-talk-instead-of-type-on-your-pc) |
| Cost and license | [Free, MIT-licensed app](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/LICENSE) | [Included with licensed Windows](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accessibility/windows/use-voice-typing-to-talk-instead-of-type-on-your-pc) |

 

## Try a local writing workflow

 

Follow [the setup guide](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/getting-started/), choose an editable field and start with short passages. Review names, numbers and punctuation. Saydraft keeps local History, offers configurable shortcuts and can apply optional on-device cleanup; release qualification remains in progress.

 

Read the [privacy explanation](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/privacy/) before using any dictation tool with sensitive text. Local processing does not replace your PC’s access controls or careful transcript review.

 

Not affiliated with Microsoft. Information checked on the date above.

## A few useful answers.

### Does standard Win+H voice typing need internet?

Microsoft documents an internet requirement for standard Windows voice typing, which uses online speech recognition. Voice Access is a separate Windows feature with offline speech recognition after setup.

### Is Saydraft a replacement for Windows Voice Access?

Saydraft focuses on dictation and text editing. It does not provide the complete Windows navigation and accessibility command system offered by Voice Access.

## Sources and further reading

- [Microsoft: use voice typing ↗](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accessibility/windows/use-voice-typing-to-talk-instead-of-type-on-your-pc)

- [Microsoft: set up Voice Access ↗](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accessibility/windows/voice-access/set-up-voice-access)

# Wispr Flow Alternative for Windows, Offline | Saydraft

Canonical: https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/wispr-flow-alternative/

Compare Saydraft with Wispr Flow for Windows dictation: local models, cloud processing, pricing and setup. Free, open-source voice typing.

Facts checked: 2026-11-14

If you want voice typing that continues after you disconnect, Saydraft offers a local route on Windows. Speech models and optional text cleanup run on your PC. The project is free and MIT licensed. An unsigned Windows portable preview is available from the [download page](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/download/), alongside source setup. Review the preview limits before relying on it for daily work.

 

Wispr Flow is a commercial dictation service for Windows and macOS. Its [documentation](https://docs.wisprflow.ai/articles/2772472373-what-is-flow) describes cloud transcription. Local transcript history and privacy preferences do not make that transcription an offline service.

 

## Compare the trade-offs

 

| Choice | Saydraft | Wispr Flow |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Speech processing | [Installed local models](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/docs/MODELS.md) | [Cloud transcription](https://docs.wisprflow.ai/articles/2772472373-what-is-flow) |
| Desktop platform | [Windows](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft) | [Windows and macOS](https://wisprflow.ai/pricing) |
| Cost | [Free, MIT licensed source](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft/blob/main/LICENSE) | [Free allowance; paid Pro](https://wisprflow.ai/pricing) |
| Current availability | [Unsigned portable preview and source](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/download/) | [Commercial product](https://wisprflow.ai/pricing) |

 

Wispr currently lists Pro at US$15 per user monthly, or US$144 per user annually. Its free plan has a weekly word allowance; check the pricing page for the current limit and billing terms. Saydraft has no subscription. Its Pro setting describes a local capability tier, rather than a paid plan.

 

## Moving a writing workflow

 

- Follow the [setup guide](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/docs/getting-started/) and explicitly install a compatible speech model.
 
- Start with a plain text editor. Hold Ctrl+Win, speak a short passage, then release. Shortcuts can be changed in Settings.
 
- Pin the [languages you use](https://tanzir71.github.io/saydraft/languages/), add names to your dictionary and review the transcript before sending it elsewhere.

 

These are familiar push-to-talk gestures; they do not import Wispr’s settings, account or vocabulary. Avoid running overlapping shortcuts in two dictation apps at once. Recognition and cleanup differ, so compare the output on your own words rather than assuming equal accuracy.

 

Not affiliated with Wispr Flow. Information checked on the date above.

## A few useful answers.

### Does Wispr Flow work without internet?

Wispr documents cloud transcription and an internet requirement. Saydraft processes speech with installed local models, which can be reused offline.

### Is Saydraft ready to replace my current dictation app?

Saydraft has an unsigned Windows portable preview and MIT-licensed source. Try it with your own vocabulary and apps first; broader accuracy and native Windows workflow acceptance remain in progress.

## Sources and further reading

- [Wispr Flow product documentation ↗](https://docs.wisprflow.ai/articles/2772472373-what-is-flow)

- [Wispr Flow pricing ↗](https://wisprflow.ai/pricing)

- [Saydraft source and implementation status ↗](https://github.com/tanzir71/saydraft)
